messages:
Noah (RevOps): Flagging a request from Sales: HelixCare (EU healthcare chain) asking for 50% off Dedicated for first 6 months + waive setup fee $20k. They want Dedicated because of data residency. If we can't meet price they'll go to competitor X.

Marta (Finance): 50% is beyond standard thresholds. Need ARR math and whether this affects our ability to meet margin targets.

Sam (Sales): If pilot converts we expect $120k/mo ARR. Pilot 6mo list = $720k. They are asking 50% on pilot and waive setup. Strong reference potential and multiple hospitals in pipeline.

Marta (Finance): Do not bundle setup waiver into committed ARR. Also propose milestone-based setup credit. Need token caps and defined SLOs.

Deal Desk Bot: Policy: discounts >=40% require CFO approval and Legal review. See https://redwood.internal/policies/discounts

Diego (CFO): Can we structure this with a 24mo post-pilot commitment and clawback of credits if they don't continue? Also require escrow or deposit covering 3 months of discounted service.

Noah (RevOps): Recommend: 50% off 6mo pilot, $20k setup credit released in 3 milestones (30/40/30), 24mo committed ARR clause, 3-month deposit, token cap 400M/mo, billing alerts.

Legal Bot: Will draft clawback language and escrow terms; note: healthcare data residency adds compliance review.

Marta (Finance): Quick P&L (pilot 6mo):
```
List pilot revenue (6mo): $720,000
50% discounted revenue (6mo): $360,000
Setup credit: $20,000
Estimated pilot delta: -$380,000
Estimated ARR if convert: $1,440,000/yr
```

Diego (CFO): Given strategic value and large ARR potential, I approve a conditional exception: 50% off for 6 months + $20k setup credit, subject to: signed 24mo commitment (or deposit in escrow equaling 3 months revenue), milestone-based credit release, token cap 400M/mo, Legal to confirm clawback language and compliance signoff. Once Legal confirms I will sign the formal exception.

Sam (Sales): Thanks all — will push for signatures and update CRM.

Deal Desk Bot: Exception recorded: exception-id=EX-2045003333 pending-legal timestamp=2045003720
